commons.description: This scene depicts the Vishnu Kurmavatara and the churning of the Milk Ocean.  The naga (king of serpents), Vasuki, is curled around the mountain Mandara.  Vishnu, incarnated in the form of a great turtle, supports the mountain on his back.  Devas (demigods) and Asuras (demons) pull on the naga's body to churn the water of the ocean for thousands of years in order to produce the nectar of immortal
